1.en_consolidated_definition:
To cut.

To sever or divide something, often with a sharp object or tool.

To interrupt or stop something, such as a conversation or activity.

To reduce or diminish the size or amount of something.

To separate or disconnect two or more things.

To remove or eliminate something, such as a part or an obstacle.
